maddeler.e:
استشعروا (form X)
# اِسْتَشْعَرُوا (istašʕarū) /is.taʃ.ʕa.ruː/: third-person masculine plural past active of اِسْتَشْعَرَ (istašʕara)
# اُسْتُشْعِرُوا (ustušʕirū) /us.tuʃ.ʕi.ruː/: third-person masculine plural past passive of اِسْتَشْعَرَ (istašʕara)
# اِسْتَشْعِرُوا (istašʕirū) /is.taʃ.ʕi.ruː/: second-person masculine plural imperative of اِسْتَشْعَرَ (istašʕara)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
